# Hand-maintained recall-probe fixture for the "universe" audit stage.
#
# PROVENANCE: this list was rebuilt from scratch on 2026-08-25 using real
# web search, deliberately NOT copied from
# src/pharma_stats/discovery/seed_assets.json (which is an INPUT to
# discovery's seed_expansion and would make the recall check circular).
# Overlap with seed_assets.json's 20 names is expected and fine — many of
# those (Enhertu, Kadcyla, Padcev, etc.) are real, well-known ADCs that any
# independent source will also surface. What matters is that the SOURCE
# here is independent of seed_assets.json, not that the names differ.
#
# This list is NOT exhaustive. It is compiled from the sources below,
# favouring recall over precision per project convention. It intentionally
# includes some non-solid-tumour (haematologic-malignancy) and some
# discontinued/early-discovery-stage assets, because the cited sources do
# not cleanly separate those and over-inclusion is preferred here; scope
# filtering to solid-tumour / industry-sponsored is a later pipeline step,
# not something to pre-filter into this fixture.
#
# Sources (all accessed 2026-08-25):
#   1. Biopharma Spec, "FDA-Approved Antibody Drug Conjugates: Full 2026
#      List" (article dated "early 2026").
#      https://biopharmaspec.com/blog/fda-approved-adc-drugs/
#   2. Maecker H, Jonnalagadda V, Bhakta S, Jammalamadaka V, Junutula JR.
#      "Exploration of the antibody-drug conjugate clinical landscape."
#      mAbs. 2023;15(1):2229101. Published online 2023-08-28.
#      https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10464553/
#      (covers 11 approved + 164 in-clinical-trial + 92 discontinued ADCs
#      as of mid-2023; used here for named clinical/discontinued examples).
#   3. ADC Review (adcreview.com), "AACR 2026: Emerging Antibody-Drug
#      Conjugates for the Treatment of Solid Tumors (Part 1)", published
#      2026-05-05.
#      https://www.adcreview.com/conference-coverage/aacr/aacr-2026-emerging-antibody-drug-conjugates-for-the-treatment-of-solid-tumors-part-1/
#   4. Biointron, "Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC) Programs to Watch in
#      2026", published 2026-01-27.
#      https://www.biointron.com/blog/antibody-drug-conjugate-adc-programs-to-watch-in-2026.html
#   5. A handful of additional names (zocilurtatug pelitecan, tilatamig
#      samrotecan, FDA018-ADC, ADCE-D01) cross-referenced via general web
#      search snippets (trade-press coverage of Zai Lab/Amgen, AstraZeneca,
#      Fudan-Zhangjiang Bio-Pharmaceutical, and Adcendo ApS pipeline news,
#      2025-2026); lower confidence than sources 1-4 but each corroborated
#      by more than one independent snippet.
#
# Format: one asset per line, "primary_name | synonym1 | synonym2 | ...".
# Lines starting with # are comments.
